title: MWCC allocator snapshots
description: Capture and compare stock MWCC register-allocator state for a specific function.
status_message: Live runner v1: allocator captures use the stock hash-gated MWCC compiler under qemu-i386 with a synchronous gdb-multiarch driver.
limitations: Capture uses the stock compiler and does not require an instrumented build.
Capture is sandbox-only; the host entry point returns sandbox_required when the Linux debugging tools are unavailable.
Qemu-emulated compiler runs are slow and can take minutes.
Allocator addresses are valid only for the hash-gated GC/1.2.5 and GC/1.2.5n compiler binaries.
Function-index mapping uses a symbol-table-order heuristic and should be checked against neighboring captures when results look wrong.

usage.agent_guidance: Use when register allocation, interference edges, coloring order, or spill choices need evidence from the stock compiler.
